name: Regenye (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of dark red, white and dark red in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Regenye (a dark red shield with a white plough and a yellow letter R) below the name REGENYE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
